 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Deni Avdija and the Portland Trail Blazers host Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and the Oklahoma City Thunder on Tuesday during the 2026-27 NBA regular season.
 The Oklahoma City Thunder have won four straight, including blowing out the Washington Wizards 114-75 on Saturday. Guard Gilgeous-Alexander scored a game-high 30 points and dished a game-high nine assists. Center Isaiah Hartenstein hauled in a game-high 14 rebounds.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Thunder vs Trail Blazers TV Channels and Live Stream Options
 Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (2).Alonzo Adams-Imagn Images
 Time: 11 p.m. ET
 Venue: Moda Center, Portland
 TV: NBC, KSBI, DirecTV
 Live stream: Hulu + Live TV, Sling TV, YouTube TV, Fubo, Thunder App
 Fans can watch the game for free most readily through the Fubo app. Fans can watch the game for free through various avenues. One option is Amazon Prime, where users can sign up for a seven-day free trial of NBA League Pass. Another option is DraftKings Sportsbook, which offers a three-month free trial. Users must submit a minimum deposit of $5. Another way for fans to watch for free is through DirecTV. Users can subscribe to DirecTV with a free-trial subscription that can be canceled before five days.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Portland Trail Blazers started the season hot at 6-1 but have lost two straight, including their most recent matchup against Victor Wembanyama and the San Antonio Spurs, 125-103, on Saturday. Forward Avdija scored a team-high 15 points, while center Yang Hansen came off the bench to secure a team-high 10 rebounds. Guard Damian Lillard dished a team-high seven assists.
 For Oklahoma City, center Thomas Sorber (knee), guard Cason Wallace (shoulder), center Chet Holmgren (knee) and guard Jalen Williams (legs) are out. Forward Jaylin Williams (back) is a game-time decision.
 For Portland, center Robert Williams III is a game-time decision due to rest, while guard Ja Morant (hamstring), guard Vit Krejci (ankle) and guard Shaedon Sharpe (knee) are out.
